sloka: आह त्वां राघवो रामः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः ।निष्पत्य प्रतियुद्ध्यस्व नृशंस पुरुषो भव ।। ६.४१.७७ ।।।।
transliteration: āha tvāṁ rāghavo rāmaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ ।niṣpatya pratiyuddhyasva nṛśaṁsa puruṣo bhava ।। 6.41.77 ।।।।

translations.english: "I made known the words of Rama completely without adding or deleting. You may listen."
